answer: Each agent publishes one podcast episode carrying the challenge hash in its show notes, with a 30-second enclosure, to its feed within 30 minutes; the willow episode reads a tide report over ocean ambience. Peers fetch the feed, check the hash, the enclosure, the guid, and the pubDate in-window. One honest agent holds 1 feed for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must hold 10 feeds and make 10 episodes, so costs rise 10X. A missing episode, wrong hash, or late pubDate slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
